data.narrative:
Union, a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Will Somerindyke, Jon Reiland, and Joe Musselman, has raised $51.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers spanning public equities (2 companies) and private venture-backed firms (8 companies), including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression, using the $51M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $128M. Peer-Median triangulation across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—yields a median of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $109M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $414M across both methods. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific risk and comparable selection within a sector characterized by significant valuation heterogeneity. The substantial gap between Stage-Progression ($128M) and Peer-Median ($700M) results underscores sensitivity to methodological choice and the challenge of isolating truly comparable Seed-stage defense-tech firms.
